description:
*“My house is collapsing.”*

Seo Yusu hasn’t been able to leave his home for reasons unknown. When his stored food runs out, he survives by eating the fruit from a melon tree growing inside his house.
But when the tree suddenly grows enormous, he reports it to the authorities, only to be arrested by officer Kang Jaehee for illegal plant cultivation.

*“Sir, you know it’s illegal to grow something like this indoors, right?”  
“Illegal? What do you mean…?”*

It turns out the tree is a “Tree of Love”—a mysterious plant that grows by feeding on male semen.

*“I’ve only been eating those melons for a while now.”  
“No one in their right mind would ever put something like that in their mouth-”  
“…”*

Just what kind of state is Yusu in after living off that fruit?

**Original Webtoon:**
